description:
TransitPulse: TransitPulse — global public transit intelligence: route reliability, delay prediction, multi-modal trip planning, city transit scores, and commute optimization for 500+ cities worldwide. NEW: rail/coach/ferry/cruise compensation recovery engine — UK Delay Repay, EU Rail 2021/782, ferry 1177/2010, coach 181/2011, US FMC cruise refunds, Athens Convention baggage — deterministic eligibility ($0.10) + citation-locked claim letters ($2.00).

Coverage: Global

Endpoints:
  • status ($0.05): Live Service Status
  • city ($0.08): City Transit Intelligence Brief
  • route ($0.08): Route Reliability Analysis
  • commute ($0.10): Commute Quality Analysis
  • airport ($0.08): Airport Transit Guide
  • agencies ($0.05): Transit Agencies Lookup
  • delays ($0.05): Current Transit Delays
  • delays-history ($0.08): Historical Delay Patterns
  • trip ($0.05): Transit Trip Planning
  • multimodal ($0.10): Multi-Modal Journey Planning
  • compare ($0.12): City-to-City Transit Comparison
  • carfree ($0.12): Car-Free Livability Score
  • visitor ($0.08): First-Timer Visitor Guide
  • coverage ($0.10): Transit Coverage Analysis
  • check ($0.05): Rail/Coach/Ferry/Cruise Compensation Eligibility Check
  • letter ($2.00): Citation-Locked Transit Compensation Claim Letter

action.description: Which endpoint to call. Options: status | city | route | commute | airport | agencies | delays | delays-history | trip | multimodal | compare | carfree | visitor | coverage | check | letter

cause.description: Disruption cause (default unknown — exemption burden is the operator's)

choice_offered.description: Coach: did the carrier offer the refund/re-routing choice — the 50% turns on this

city.description: City name (e.g. London, NYC, Tokyo; default: London)

claim_value.description: Ship baggage: documented damages with currency

corridor.description: Canada VIA: journey on the Quebec City-Windsor Corridor

country.description: ISO country of the journey/scheme (GB, FR, DE, US, CA, IN, JP, ... or EU)

damage_apparent.description: Ship baggage (cabin): was the damage apparent at disembarkation

delay_days.description: Cruise: voyage delay in calendar days (FMC 3-day rule)

delay_minutes.description: Arrival delay in minutes (rail/ferry); DEPARTURE delay for coach

disembark_date.description: Ship baggage: disembarkation date (Athens Art. 15 notice window + Art. 16 bar)

distance_km.description: Coach: scheduled service distance (Reg 181/2011 applies from 250 km)

express_surcharge.description: Japan JR: limited-express surcharge paid (the refundable component)

journey_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD — computes claim deadlines (UK 28 days, ferry 2 months, coach 3 months, JR 1 year)

line.description: Specific line or route to focus on

route.description: Line or route name (e.g. L train, Northern line)

scheduled_journey_hours.description: Ferry: scheduled crossing duration — selects the Art. 19 band

scheme.description: UK operator Delay Repay threshold (default DR30, conservative)

ticket_price.description: Fare paid — percentage regimes compute the amount from this

ticket_type.description: UK Delay Repay percentages differ by ticket type

travelled.description: India TDR + FMC cruise refunds require you did NOT travel

name: transitpulse
